question: Do the four additional physically matched Cyton channels F3/F4/C3/C4 improve participant-independent fatigue-vs-wakefulness recognition beyond T7/T8/O1/O2?
hypothesis: Fixed eight-channel DE features improve mean participant macro-F1 over the four-channel overlap under identical preprocessing and splits.
falsification: A paired participant bootstrap 95% confidence interval for eight-minus-four mean macro-F1 includes zero, or the gain is below 0.02.
dataset: MPD-DF raw EEG and physician annotations; Figshare article 28455737
target: binary wakefulness (published label 0) versus fatigue/sleep (published labels 1-4); published artifact/abnormal labels excluded
label_limitations: Labels are physician interpretations of EEG, not independent PERCLOS or subjective reports. This experiment cannot be compared numerically with SEED-VIG PERCLOS regression.
window: non-overlapping 8 s, 250 Hz after resampling; reject windows crossing any annotation boundary; first 15 windows of each participant for unlabeled calibration only
preprocessing: continuous 500-to-250 Hz resample; continuous 50 Hz Q5 notch and 1-45 Hz 4th-order bandpass; five continuous 4th-order DE bands 1-4,4-8,8-14,14-31,31-50 Hz; per-subject first-120-s mean/std calibration; causal EMA alpha 0.25
split: 50 participant-grouped leave-one-subject-out folds; complete recordings and all their windows stay together
model: LogisticRegression C=0.3, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=400, fixed random_state=0; identical hyperparameters and fitting budget in both feature sets
primary_metric: mean participant macro-F1 with fixed classes [wake, fatigue] and zero_division=0
secondary_metrics: participant balanced accuracy when both classes are present
decision_rule: Consider eight-channel deployment only if paired CI lower bound > 0 and mean macro-F1 gain >= 0.02; otherwise retain four-channel prototype. Deployment still requires Cyton numerical-parity and quality-gate validation.
note: Exploratory model-selection experiment; no current-wearer accuracy or PL acceleration claim.
